cohort: The study included 20 term infants with and 21 term infants without in utero SSRI exposure, excluding those who were premature, small or large for gestational age, required respiratory/cardiovascular support, or had major congenital malformations.
finding: Infants exposed to in utero SSRIs showed significantly reduced right ventricular dimensions in diastole and left ventricular lengths in both diastole and systole compared to unexposed infants.
birth_weight: Appropriate for gestational age (exclusion of small or large for gestational age)
